notes: Uses the actual production GeminiProvider and graph; only the fetch transport is observed.
Pacing is between cases, outside the 45-second agent budget. Application timeouts, prompts, schema and validators are unchanged.
Synthetic fixture inputs and model outputs are retained for diagnosis; credentials, authorization headers, cookies and request URLs are not recorded.
No ledger writes; no fallback; no case retries. Structural repair remains part of the original graph and counts as a model call.
